verdict.rationale: Lovable's docs say a single description produces a working app with frontend, backend, database, authentication and integrations as editable code. A login prompt yields both the UI pages and the backend wiring with row-level security, and the database schema is created from chat. Community reports corroborate full-stack generation (a CTO building internal CRUD tools, a site whose generated backend ran on Cloudflare Workers), though they flag mediocre code quality, poor performance and single-file sprawl. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that custom backend business logic (edge functions) is generated from the prompt, and independent evidence of production-grade backend code quality.
